title: How value reaches people
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: one power cut followed from the first call to the lights coming back on; a value stream seen from the customer's side, the processes behind it in four groups and three levels, their edges, and detail only where a rule depends on order and state.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Amber chevrons are a value stream's stages; yellow is the business layer, where processes live; salmon is information. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
